skill_name: Create a story about a boy saving a kitten from a tree.
workflow: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Jack who lived in a small village. One day, while walking home from school, Jack heard a loud meowing sound coming from the direction of a nearby tree. He looked up and saw a tiny white and gray kitten stuck in the branches of the tree. The tree was too high for Jack to climb and the branches were too weak to hold him, so he had to think of another way to save the kitten.
